body:
This mod turns regular Minecraft into an unpredictable show, where the server itself becomes your opponent. A red timer in the corner of the screen counts down the seconds until the next event, and this is the only thing you know in advance.
What can happen:
🐔 Chicken Revenge - 10 aggressive chickens attack you without warning.

💀 Red Skeleton - a rare named boss with a bow appears in front of you.

🌀 Club - all mobs start spinning and jumping as the day and night change. Final - they fly into the air.

☀️ Daytime monsters - 20 minutes mobs do not burn in the sun.

🎉 Party - 2 minutes of chaos: events every few seconds, day and night blink.

🎲 Randomizer - any broken block drops anything: from dirt to elitra.

😴 Insomnia - beds are not available for several game days.

🕶️ Darkness - all players are blinded for 5 minutes.

🌍 Flying Islands - generated directly above the head.

⚔️ Monster Pact - choose a clan of allies (zombies, skeletons, spiders, or endermen), and they will stop attacking you - for.Version 1.20.1 of Mina,modaler 47.2.0.
